title: Revisiting Critic Estimation in Soft Actor-Critic Algorithms
abstract: arXiv:2611.05666v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) is a widely used deep reinforcement learning algorithm that combines entropy regularization with an actor-critic architecture. Standard implementations rely on one-step temporal-difference learning of Q-functions, yet alternative critic design choices remain underexplored. In this work, we revisit three such choices: learning soft advantages instead of soft Q-values, the use of multi-step return targets, and the training of multi-step critics from replay buffer data. translated_title: 重新审视Soft Actor-Critic算法中的Critic估计
translated_abstract: Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) 是一种广泛使用的深度强化学习算法，它将熵正则化与actor-critic架构相结合。标准实现依赖于对Q函数的一步时序差分学习，然而其他替代性的critic设计选择仍然未被充分探索。在这项工作中，我们重新审视了三个这样的设计选择：学习软优势函数而非软Q值、使用多步回报目标，以及从经验回放缓冲区数据训练多步critic。在保持策略目标不变的情况下，我们比较了这些选择所产生的六种critic变体：(i) 从单步转移学习的advantage critic和 (ii) dueling-advantage critic，以及分别 (iii, iv) 在线策略上或 (v, vi) 从回放轨迹片段中学习的λ-return critic和软广义优势估计（GAE）critic。每种变体都在十四个任务上通过完整的随机超参数搜索进行评估，将超参数……
tldr: 该论文在固定策略目标的前提下，系统性地重新审视并比较了SAC算法中六种critic设计变体（软优势vs软Q值、多步回报目标、在线或回放数据训练）在十四个任务上的表现。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically revisits and compares six critic design variants in SAC—learning soft advantages vs. soft Q-values, multi-step return targets, and multi-step critics trained either on-policy or from replayed trajectories—across fourteen tasks while keeping the policy objective fixed.
